title: If somebody has to die
body:
Haji X. is very ill... Take him out of hospital... Where there is pain, put your hand and recite Fatiha seven
times... I am around him, blowing on his face... If he passes away, Angels will take his body to Damascus...
When Mehdi a.s. comes, I will call him from Barzakh... So many people are going to come back from Barzakh
with Grandsheikh, to follow Sayidina Imam (Mehdi).
01.04.1999
